gates.name: Day-1 scope and exclusions
gates.closeWhen: Every EOS family is classified as Day 1, post-Day-1, pilot, or excluded; explicit exclusions are accepted.

gates.name: Commercial model
gates.closeWhen: Implementation, subscription, support, founding-customer treatment, change requests, and billable custom work are priced and accepted.

gates.name: Executed customer agreements
gates.closeWhen: Applicable subscription/service terms, implementation SOW, data/confidentiality terms, support terms, liability boundaries, termination, and data-return terms are executed.

gates.name: Data migration scope and rehearsal
gates.closeWhen: Source systems are inventoried, migration tiers and mappings are accepted, at least one repeatable rehearsal is completed, and exceptions are reconciled.
evidence: PR #1802 / ccd3f2d2 records the Lane B seeded-evidence rule and the successful B-05 canary at lane commit 2f262d38: deterministic SEEDED/SYNTHETIC source records, census/tiering/mapping fixtures, a repeatable migration dry-run harness, deterministic exception reporting, and passing targeted proofs. This materially proves the migration PROCESS can be rehearsed without waiting for a Taylor export; it does not prove Taylor's actual source data, accepted mappings, real exceptions, or Taylor acceptance, so this gate remains OPEN.

gates.name: Opening inventory reconciliation
gates.closeWhen: Opening warehouse, bin, truck, and serialized inventory is reconciled to an accepted operational baseline and Taylor records acceptance.

gates.name: Production identities and roles
gates.closeWhen: The production user roster is reconciled and each Day-1 persona is verified at least privilege against production authorities.

gates.name: Taylor administrative self-service
gates.closeWhen: Designated Taylor EOS administrators can perform ordinary Day-1 administration without source-code changes, CLI commands, direct database edits, or Verenward engineering.

gates.name: Day-1 workflow readiness
gates.closeWhen: Every Day-1 workflow has passed its applicable governed functional, sandbox, North Star, and acceptance gates.
evidence: docs/design/north-star-migration-ledger.md

The original PHYSICAL_CONSUMPTION blocker is therefore CLOSED IN RUNNING SANDBOX BEHAVIOR, not merely closed in code. This does not establish production deployment.

PR #1800 / c6ad5b68: the dashboard corrective chain was live-verified on platform-sandbox Hosting 6b281cd5. Taylor's actual deployment profile remains a customer/accounting choice and is not inferred here.

gates.name: Production security and authority verification
gates.authority: Verenward + Owner for protected production actions
gates.closeWhen: Production Rules, Functions, capabilities, roles, protected actions, tenant boundaries, and audit behavior are verified from the production environment for Day-1 scope.
evidence: Repository and sandbox governance evidence exists; production evidence remains required.

PR #1752 / be1e5579: read-only production R-32 exposure census found zero exposed principals and zero writes/deploys. It also found production is barely using the governed access model: two RoleAssignments on one principal, no manager Roles, and no location scopes. This narrows one production exposure question but does not satisfy full Day-1 production identity/authority verification.

PR #1768 / 0dd5e104 and #1779 / 7c5c39dc: Reporting now has a distinct activation/adoption boundary. Production adoption of the approved 25-capability set is representable in repository configuration, but the work explicitly records it as not live production evidence.

gates.name: Backup and restore proof
gates.closeWhen: Backup policy is defined and a documented restore procedure has been tested with integrity verification.

gates.name: Taylor interruption fallback
gates.closeWhen: Taylor has documented practical fallback/reconciliation procedures for critical Day-1 operations during an EOS interruption.

gates.name: Support and escalation model
gates.closeWhen: Official support intake, severity definitions, escalation, support hours/expectations, bug-vs-enhancement boundary, and third-party IT responsibility are operational and contracted where required.

gates.name: Day-1 training readiness
gates.closeWhen: Every Day-1 role/workflow has current training matching the deployed product, designated Taylor administrators are trained, and the permanent deployment training-close gate is operational.
evidence: docs/training/README.md
docs/training/PURCHASING_RECORD_PURCHASE_ORDER.md exists as a deployment-gated user guide for the governed purchase-order price-entry behavior; its completion state remains tied to live verification.
PR #1792 / c6589c06 originally closed docs/training/MY_DASHBOARD.md for My Dashboard against the Owner-accepted sandbox behavior.

PR #1800 / c6ad5b68: docs/training/MY_DASHBOARD.md is COMPLETE — LIVE VERIFIED against platform-sandbox commit 6b281cd5 and now explicitly covers both My Dashboard and Technician Dashboard, including the post-acceptance corrective chain. This closes training for those two dashboard surfaces only; it does not satisfy the all-Day-1-role/workflow close condition.

gates.name: Cutover rehearsal and authorization package
gates.closeWhen: Source freeze, final exports, migration, reconciliation, user activation, smoke tests, fallback, and signoff are rehearsed and packaged for the final production action.

gates.name: Customer 1 CI cost containment
gates.closeWhen: Ledger/documentation-only updates do not trigger broad application CI or GitHub Pages rebuilds, and no Windows-hosted Actions are used for ledger automation.
evidence: PR #1726 merged as 606278d2fcaf2aa26290d97d5c7f0f455c03dc9e; GitHub Pages is now path-filtered and remains ubuntu-latest.

Measured on docs-only Customer 1 reconciliation commit 72be6c52: no GitHub Pages deployment was triggered, but Vite Build Check and Operational Payload Guard still ran. Therefore the original READY claim was too broad and this gate is reopened until broad application CI is also excluded for ledger/training-only changes.

PR #1802 head d52dab2a changed exactly one docs/customer-1 charter file and still triggered Vite Build Check, Operational Payload Guard, and Secret scan. This independently confirms broad application CI isolation remains incomplete; no GitHub Pages or Windows-hosted runner evidence was observed.
No Windows-hosted Action was introduced or observed in this reconciliation.

gates.name: Final production dependency authorization
gates.closeWhen: All launch-critical gates are READY and the Owner explicitly authorizes Taylor to depend on EOS in production from the reviewed release/cutover package.
